Specification of Communication Management
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
contain the serialized application error according to [SWS_CM_10428]. In case
that an E2E Error response shall be sent (see [SWS_CM_10472]) the Payload
shall contain the data according to [SWS_CM_00033] and serialized according
to [SWS_CM_10428].
⌋
The SOME/IP serialization rules are explained in section 7.2.1.9.
[SWS_CM_10428] payload representing application error
Upstream requirements:
RS_SOMEIP_00014
⌈

of the union shall be set to 0x01. The element of the union with type field set to 0x01
shall be a SOME/IP struct with the following elements in depicted order:

uint64
